input.title: Goa Squad: Beaches, Feni and Full-Moon Nights
input.summary: Four friends split time between Candolim and Anjuna beaches, Goan seafood, and Baga and Anjuna nightlife, with a Coldplay tribute concert on the 21st. The stay is at the Veera Marina pool apartment, close to the Candolim sights.

stops.why: Easy sunset beach stroll right after everyone regroups at the hotel.
Seafood dinner at a well-reviewed garden restaurant, perfect for the squad's food craving.
Kick off the nightlife with a disco close to the hotel.
Morning fort visit with sea views before the day heats up.
Lunch at a highly rated bistro in Candolim, close to the fort.
Candlelight tribute concert on the squad's trip dates, a fun group outing.
Lively Goan dinner spot in Calangute with late hours for the group.
Late-night club in Baga for the squad's nightlife interest.
Morning on the famous Calangute beach, great for a relaxed start.
Seafood lunch by the water in Nerul, a fresh catch for food lovers.
Mandrem's quiet, open-all-day beach for a golden afternoon.
Highly rated continental dinner in Anjuna, a good pre-party meal.
Iconic Anjuna beach shack club to close out the squad's last full night.
Relaxed breakfast in Anjuna to fuel the last morning together.
Quick cafe stop in Vagator before the airport run.

input.changeNote: Ishita now has the cheapest flights both ways. Everyone else's flights, the hotel and the day plans are unchanged.
